title: Panel Circuit Ops — Standup Sprint 39 (UI / Rollouts / Analytics)
content:
Date: 2026-09-07
Time: 09:15-09:35 PT (20m) — quick cadence one-pager capture
Attendees: Maya P. (owner), Diego M., Lena F., Omar R., Priya S., Alex G. (PM), Sam K. (analytics)
Location: Zoom + #panel-ops Slack thread (see linked_artifacts)

TL;DR:
- UI: Polished the new panel editor keyboard flow; one regressions bug surfaced with nested cards, patch scheduled for tomorrow.
- Rollouts: Canary for panel-v2 targeted at 5% users in EU/NA; metrics look clean but a ~1.8x increase in Redis ops for certain routes. Investigating batching.
- Analytics: Dashboards updated to split by model-route and rollout-variant; need a single metric to trigger automatic rollback alert (proposal below).

Detailed notes: 
1) UI (Maya / Diego / Lena)
- What went well: keyboard nav now respects nested card focus; accessibility checks passed for primary flows.
- Work in progress: nested-card drag/drop still stutters on Safari (reported on MacOS 14). Diego reproduced, root cause seems to be event-coalescing + transform style thrash.
- Bug: CON-4198 — when a panel contains >12 cards, rendering pipeline defers mount and loses local focus state. Patch branch: fix/preserve-focus-4198 (PR draft). Priority P1 for small set of customer pages.
- Next steps: Diego to land fix + smoke test on staging by 2026-09-08 EOD; Lena to write a short regression test and add to the playwright matrix (target 2026-09-10).

2) Rollouts & Traffic Shaping (Omar / Alex)
- Canary details: panel-v2 deployed to canary pool (5% traffic NA/EU) since 2026-09-06 14:00 UTC.
- Observed: latency p50 unchanged, p95 +120ms on /render-panel for requests with longer token contexts; Redis LMSET ops increased ~1.8x for a subsegment (~3% of requests) where we didn't batch prefix cache calls.
- Hypothesis: new rendering pipeline issues inefficient cache access pattern for composed panels.
- Mitigation: throttled canary to 2% in NA while teams instrument batching fix. Omar to push a config change to canary policy by 2026-09-07 12:00 PT.
- Rollback policy discussion: we need an automated rule that triggers if p95 latency increases by >50ms AND error_rate > 0.5% for >5 mins. Alex to open CON-4240 to formalize rule and hook into rollout controller.

3) Analytics & Observability (Sam / Priya)
- Dashboard updates: new breakdown metrics added — render_time_by_variant, kv-store_ops_by_route, cache_hit_ratio_by_prefix. Sam shared short notes on thresholds.
- Alerting gap: currently multiple alerts fire separately; we want a composite alert (single signal) for rollout regressions. Proposed composite: (p95_delta > 50ms OR error_rate_delta > 0.5%) AND kv_ops_increase > 1.5x. Sam to prototype in Grafana Alerting by 2026-09-09.
- Data quality: sample rate for telemetry trimmed to 25% on warm paths; need to ensure this doesn't skew p95 calc. Priya to validate on staging traces (CON-4123).

4) Cross-team dependencies
- Serving-runtime: need a small server-side change to expose per-request kv-op counts in header for accurate attribution. Repo: infra/serving-instrumentation. Diego to sync with Kunal (serving) — meeting scheduled 2026-09-08 10:00 PT.
- Deploy infra: require short maintenance window to scale Redis cluster by +1 shard to absorb canary burst. Infra team (SRE) asked to schedule 30-min slot 2026-09-09 02:00-02:30 UTC.

Blockers / Risks:
- Regressions bug (CON-4198) could affect a small set of customers if not fixed within 48h.
- Increased Redis ops during canary could cause noisy neighbors; mitigations: reduce canary percentage, add Redis pooling throttle.
- Lack of a composite rollback signal increases manual ops load during rollout.

Action items (owner — due):
- Diego M. — land fix for CON-4198, push branch to PR for review (due 2026-09-08 EOD).
- Lena F. — add playwright regression test + matrix entry for nested cards (due 2026-09-10).
- Omar R. — lower canary to 2% NA and push routing config (due 2026-09-07 12:00 PT).
- Alex G. — create JIRA CON-4240 to formalize automated rollback rule and link to rollout controller (due 2026-09-08).
- Sam K. — prototype composite alert in Grafana & share runbook snippet (due 2026-09-09).
- Priya S. — validate telemetry sample rate impact on p95 calculation and report anomalies (due 2026-09-08).
- Maya P. — coordinate customer comms if a wider rollback is needed; draft templated note (due 2026-09-10).

Decisions made:
- Canary kept but reduced to 2% in NA until we confirm batching fix avoids Redis ops spike.
- Rollout controller will adopt a composite rollback rule (Alex to spec).
- Short-term: prioritize focus-preserve UI fix before next major deployment.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Should we tweak sampling on high-latency endpoints to 50% for the duration of canary? Risk: higher volume + cost. Proposal: enable increased sampling only for a 24h window during active troubleshooting. (Owner: Priya)
- Can the serving-runtime expose kv-op counts without payload bloat? Follow-up with Kunal and infra.

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is a working capture of the 20m standup; please comment inline in the doc or post to #panel-ops if you need edits.
- If you want to join the deeper triage session (30m) for the Redis ops investigation, meeting scheduled 2026-09-07 15:00 PT — invite in calendar.

Appendix (short links):
- CON-4198 (bug): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CON-4198
- CON-4123 (telemetry): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CON-4123

End of capture.
